main_body: adobe desert building with flat roof terrace and front wall
top_band: light tan and brown roof terrace with parapet wall, rug, and trapdoor, rows 1-31
evidence: Rows 1-31 show the horizontal flat roof terrace from above, framed by a raised parapet (with inner drop shadow on rows 3-5) and featuring a rug and ladder opening. Rows 30-31 form the light front parapet edge, rows 32-33 form the dark overhang shadow, and rows 34-63 show the vertical front wall with inset beam holes, arched doorway, and lattice window.

style.evidence: Richly textured adobe plaster and roof sand using 5-6 warm earth steps, dark brown material-toned outlines, detailed brick exposures, roof rug, trapdoor, and lattice window matching Beodeul density and craft.
